svg.title: Lobry de Bruyn–van Ekenstein transformation
svg.text: glucose ⇌ enediol ⇌ fructose in dilute alkali
The enediol can also re-protonate at C-2 on the other face → D-mannose (C-2 epimer of glucose).
Result: an equilibrium mixture of D-glucose, D-fructose and D-mannose (industry: glucose isomerase → high-fructose syrup).
